model.quantization: NVFP4 checkpoint with the existing FreeToken native backends

process_topology.process_a: coordinator and entrance block in a fresh CUDA context on Block A GPU
process_topology.process_b: persistent final-block service in a separately spawned fresh CUDA context on Block B GPU
process_topology.loader: each process independently uses the N0 selective loader

transport.connection_lifetime: one connection reused for the full service lifetime and all sequential N1 sessions
transport.tensor_serialization: raw contiguous bytes; no pickle or JSON
transport.replaceability: UnixSocketTransport may be replaced by a later TcpTransport without changing frame or block semantics; N1 contains no TCP implementation

handshake.encoding: length-prefixed UTF-8 scalar fields plus fixed-width numeric fields; no JSON
handshake.mismatch_behavior: fail closed before OPEN_SESSION or model execution
handshake.role_validation: A asserts entrance/coordinator role and B asserts final/service role

boundary_tensor.semantic_point: exact output residual-stream pair after global layer 18 and input residual-stream pair to global layer 19
boundary_tensor.source_runtime_detail: Qwen3.6 internally keeps layer output as a BF16 (hidden,residual) pair for fused add+RMSNorm
boundary_tensor.materialization: none; Process A serializes hidden followed by residual without numeric conversion, and Process B reconstructs both before global layer 19
boundary_tensor.why_two_planes_are_required: source inspection showed that global layer 19 consumes both members through fused add+RMSNorm. Real prefill and established-context decode probes showed that both plain BF16 addition and backend-assisted pre-materialization changed downstream activations, although the two diagnostic tokens happened to remain unchanged. Exact semantics therefore require both planes.
boundary_tensor.pre_retained_probe_result: two one-plane materialization alternatives rejected; retained N1 execution must use the exact residual pair
boundary_tensor.layout: two consecutive C-contiguous row-major BF16 planes: hidden[token_count,2048] then residual[token_count,2048], equivalently residual_pair[2,token_count,2048]

session_lifecycle.prefill_semantics: one or more contiguous chunks, maximum 8192 tokens per chunk; chunks carry absolute_start_position and final_chunk flag; only the final chunk produces TOKEN_RESULT
session_lifecycle.decode_semantics: exactly one BF16 hidden vector at the next expected absolute position per request step
session_lifecycle.reset_semantics: zero/release all block-local KV and recurrent state and reset expected position before another session

token_result.selection: greedy argmax after Block B final norm and LM head
token_result.diagnostic_logits: may be hashed/compared locally in Process B only and are disabled for boundary-size and performance evidence

required: one stable CUDA graph per block
one graph replay per block per token
all block expert weights resident before retained decode
fast_path_validity.allowed_host_boundary: one A-to-B hidden-state staging/socket boundary and one B-to-A token-result boundary per token
fast_path_validity.prefill: may use the existing eager backend-native prefill path

correctness_rules.boundary_transport: exact SHA-256 before/after for prefill and established-context decode
correctness_rules.generated_tokens: complete W1-W4 sequences and stopping point exactly equal to frozen unsplit reference
correctness_rules.selected_logits: exact equality at steps 0,1,15,31; record max absolute, max relative, NaN and Inf
correctness_rules.state: each process state hash agrees with its independently validated reference at an established-context checkpoint
correctness_rules.session_leakage: same-prompt reset session equals fresh reference and a different prompt is uncontaminated
